	NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_concord_charter_recent }

		check_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = 0 }

			check_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = 1 }
			OVERLORD = {
				has_country_flag = zin_aenor_golden_charters_open

				OR = {
					zin_aenor_king_alive = yes
					zin_aenor_ruled_by_court = yes

			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = 2 }
			has_global_flag = zin_lost_cause_shield

			check_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = 3 }
